testsuite.name: org.thoughtcrime.securesms.groups.GroupManagerV2Test_edit

testcase.name: when you are the only admin, and then leave the group, server upgrades all other members to administrators and lets you leave
demoting an admin who has a label does not clear the label when label access is open to all members
demoting an admin who has a label clears the label when label access is restricted to only admins
restricting label access to admins only clears non-admins that have labels set
restricting label access to admins only does not modify labels of admins that have labels set
when admin terminates group, the group state is updated with terminated flag
